set.body:
Owner: fit/model/ar with dataset readers. Consumer: PLS Neuro W4 bd-01M1YVQ4K757TYE07WH4K787MB. Public FmriFitResult provides variance, rank, covariance, AR coefficients and whitening segment diagnostics. GLS residualMatrix and whitening context are private; no public fit-bound observed/fitted/residual trace and ACF contract was found in the admitted source. Public bounded series reads alone do not safely reconstruct the fitted transform. Preserve existing AR/GLS kernels and scenario evidence (ArCensorBoundaryGlsScenarioSuite).
Deliver an explicitly bounded selected-voxel diagnostic request against verified data, exact model plan and fit provenance. Expose original and transformed diagnostic spaces honestly, including selected rows, run/censor boundaries, whitening scope/estimated coefficients, and source/voxel identity. Voxelwise AR cannot imply one universal whitened design. ACF must use declared lag units and gap policy; provide unavailable/refused states for unsupported engines/transform receipts and stale or incompatible inputs. Never silently refit or diagnose a different averaged signal. Reuse native kernels rather than client X-beta arithmetic.
Acceptance: independent OLS and fixed known-covariance GLS calculations, estimated AR cases, multi-run censor gaps, shared/voxelwise scope, chunk/budget invariance, source mismatch, cancellation and residual-space identity. Shared JVM+JS checks plus bounded IO consumer. This task does not grant PLS inference eligibility; current unwhitened OLS admission remains distinct. Implementation remains open.
set.title: Fit review: expose bounded identified residual traces for OLS and AR GLS
